summary: A Community installation can now move to Pro without reinstalling.

new.title: Upgrade Community to Pro in place
new.text: Register a Pro licence on the Licence page and Pro features switch on at once. One command then adds automatic Pro updates.

fixes.title: Pro shown only when it unlocks
fixes.text: A licence for another tenant, or one that is not Pro, is now refused when you register it.

fixes.title: "Managing tenant" and "managed tenant"
fixes.text: These names replace the old MSP wording everywhere you read them. Nothing you stored changes.

fixes.title: New group roles no longer fail
fixes.text: A new role-assignable group's first eligibility now shows as waiting and applies on the next run, instead of failing.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Create Discovered Resources now sits right under Create access.
